name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Frame-adjustable, predictive input buffer and hazard assist for the Cube and the Wave, with live console output.

cube-assist.name: Cube assist
cube-assist.description: Buffers early clicks and delays landing jumps so they clear the hazard ahead.

cube-window.name: Cube window (frames @ 60Hz)
cube-window.description: How early a click is remembered, and the most a jump may be delayed to clear a hazard. 0 = off.

cube-margin.name: Cube clearance margin (units)
cube-margin.description: Extra height required over a hazard when planning a jump.

wave-assist.name: Wave assist
wave-assist.description: Overrides hold/release when your input would hit a hazard and a safe alternative exists.

wave-window.name: Wave window (frames @ 60Hz)
wave-window.description: How far ahead the Wave assist plans. Small = only steps in when death is imminent.

wave-margin.name: Wave hazard margin (units)
wave-margin.description: Hazard hitboxes are inflated by this much when planning.

wave-solids.name: Treat solid blocks as deadly (Wave)
wave-solids.description: Conservative. Off by default because the Wave can slide along some surfaces.

wave-floor-y.name: Wave floor Y (0 = off)
wave-floor-y.description: Game-space Y of the floor the Wave slides along.

wave-ceiling-y.name: Wave ceiling Y (0 = off)
wave-ceiling-y.description: Game-space Y of the ceiling the Wave slides along.

wave-flip-gravity.name: Hold moves down when gravity flipped
wave-flip-gravity.description: Enable if the Wave assist seems backwards in upside-down sections.

console-output.name: Console output
console-output.description: Print assist actions to Geode's log/console (enable Geode's "Show Platform Console" to see it in its own window).
